title: 4GB graphics cards are back
excerpt: ASRock is launching an AMD Radeon RX 9050 with 4GB of VRAM, a first in modern graphics cards, as component shortages continue to raise prices.
content_html:
Skip to main content

﻿ASRock’s Radeon RX 9050 is the first modern GPU in years to include only 4GB of VRAM.

﻿ASRock’s Radeon RX 9050 is the first modern GPU in years to include only 4GB of VRAM.

by Stevie Bonifield

Jul 28, 2026, 3:52 PM UTC

Image: ASRock

Stevie Bonifield

is a news writer covering all things consumer tech. Stevie started out at Laptop Mag writing news and reviews on hardware, gaming, and AI.

The first modern GPU with 4GB of VRAM has appeared, as RAM prices and component shortages push tech prices higher. As Digital Foundry reports, a listing for an AMD Radeon RX 9050 with 4GB of RAM was spotted on ASRock’s website by a user on X, the same day ASRock also launched an 8GB version of the RX 9050.

Does it make sense to buy a graphics card with just 4GB of VRAM? According to the specs on ASRock’s website, the 4GB version of the RX 9050 is built on AMD’s RDNA 4 architecture and has a 64-bit memory interface, 16 compute units, and a boost clock speed of up to 2,600MHz / 18GBps. That should be enough to enable new features like FSR 4, but is far below the suggested requirements of current AAA titles like Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced and Halo: Campaign Evolved, even if you’re willing to run at 1080p and aren’t worried about future proofing.

While ASRock has not yet announced pricing for the 4GB RX 9050, Tom’s Hardware spotted it in a Best Buy listing for an $889 prebuilt gaming PC that also includes 8GB of DDR4 RAM, 500GB of SSD storage, and an AMD Ryzen 5 5500 CPU.

ASRock and AMD did not immediately respond to a request for on the record comment.

作者：史蒂维·博尼菲尔德

世界标准时间 2026 年 7 月 28 日下午 3:52

图片：华擎

史蒂维·博尼菲尔德

是一位涵盖消费科技所有领域的新闻撰稿人。 Stevie 最初在 Laptop Mag 撰写有关硬件、游戏和人工智能的新闻和评论。

随着 RAM 价格和组件短缺推高技术价格，首款配备 4GB VRAM 的现代 GPU 已经出现。 据 Digital Foundry 报道，X 用户在华擎网站上发现了配备 4GB RAM 的 AMD Radeon RX 9050 的列表，同一天华擎还推出了 8GB 版本的 RX 9050。

购买只有 4GB VRAM 的显卡有意义吗？ 根据华擎网站上的规格，4GB 版本的 RX 9050 基于 AMD 的 RDNA 4 架构构建，拥有 64 位内存接口、16 个计算单元和高达 2,600MHz / 18GBps 的加速时钟速度。 这应该足以启用 FSR 4 等新功能，但远远低于当前 AAA 游戏（例如《刺客信条：黑旗重新同步》和《光环：战役进化》）的建议要求，即使您愿意以 1080p 运行并且不担心未来的验证。

虽然华擎尚未公布 4GB RX 9050 的定价，但 Tom’s Hardware 在百思买清单中发现了这款 889 美元的预装游戏 PC，该 PC 还包括 8GB DDR4 RAM、500GB SSD 存储和 AMD Ryzen 5 5500 CPU。

华擎和 AMD 没有立即回应公开评论的请求。
